messages:
marta (compliance): FYI external auditor Jane asked for a bundle of artifacts for the upcoming ISO/SOC collection. Putting questions here so eng-security can chime in.
jane_auditor: Hi team — can you provide: 1) evidence of recent RBAC changes and approver trail, 2) audit log retention proof and sample logs, 3) KMS key metadata + rotation proof, 4) a vuln triage ticket showing patching timeline for a recent CVE, and 5) incident response runbook + results from last tabletop? Need by EOD Fri. Thanks :slightly_smiling_face:
emma (sec-eng): @marta @raj ack. I'll pull RBAC ACL diffs and cloud audit logs. For RBAC changes we keep PRs + approval comments in github and also log entries in Cloud Audit Logs when IAM bindings change.
raj (infra-sec): For KMS: our customer keys live in GCP KMS (project redwood-prod-kms). Rotation is automatic every 90 days via key version schedule. I can export key metadata and rotation history.
emma (sec-eng): Quick note on how I'll grab the IAM change evidence:
```
# list IAM admin audit entries for the last 90d
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy" OR protoPayload.methodName:"PatchServiceAccount"' --project=redwood-prod --freshness=90d --format=json > /tmp/iam_changes.json
```
I will redact SIDs and upload the JSON sample to the secure audit bucket.
marta (compliance): auditor also asked for retention policy config + proof logs showing retention is respected (not just policy).
raj (infra-sec): Retention is enforced in Cloud Logging via sink->BigQuery with lifecycle policy. Proof: show dataset TTL config + example log row timestamp older than TTL cutoff flagged for export. I'll grab dataset metadata and a short query result.
emma (sec-eng): On vuln triage: reference is CVE-2025-1459 (example). We tracked in JIRA SEC-4721. Triage timeline:
- 2025-02-03: vuln reported (oss scan)
- 2025-02-04: severity review, assigned to eng-runtime
- 2025-02-07: patch merged and deployed
I'll attach the JIRA changelog and deployment job link.
jane_auditor: Please include evidence that the fix reached production (deployment job + post-deploy smoke test logs).
emma (sec-eng): will do. Example of deployment evidence I'll include:
```
- CI job: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/deploy-runtime/523
- smoke logs: deploy-runtime/523/post-deploy.log (contains: "smoke-tests: PASS")
```
incident-bot: Tabletop exercise recorded: tabletop-2025-02-10, runbook used: IR-Runbook-v3.1, outcome: escalation chain validated. Recording uploaded to internal vault.
marta (compliance): Auditor: can you confirm a secure upload location and whether we should send raw logs or redacted samples?
jane_auditor: We need raw logs for verification but only via your secure auditor-share S3/GCS path with IAM-limited access. Redacted samples are fine for initial review but final verification requires originals.
raj (infra-sec): I will put originals into a locked GCS bucket: gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/ with a short TTL and grant auditor_jane@audit-firm.com object-level read for 30 days. I'll also generate SHA256 checksums and an access manifest.
emma (sec-eng): For RBAC approvals: I'll export the GitHub PRs referencing the IAM change (PRs: #1123, #1140) and include approver comments and SSO login audit correlation (we map GitHub handle -> SSO email in audit). Example GitHub API curl to export:
```
curl -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/runtime/pulls/1123
```
marta (compliance): Also need control mapping doc linking each artifact to control IDs (ISO 27001 A.9 / SOC2 CC6 etc). I can assemble the mapping once artifacts are in gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/.
jane_auditor: That works. One last ask: incident postmortem with timeline and root cause for the most recent Sev2 in Jan 2025.
emma (sec-eng): PM is ENG-INC-2025-01-19, I'll include the redacted postmortem PDF and the timeline CSV. CC: @raj for logs.parsing.
raj (infra-sec): Upload plan:
- gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/iam_changes.json (raw)
- gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/kms_metadata.json
- gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/SEC-4721-jira-export.json
- gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/IR-Runbook-v3.1.pdf
Access manifest: /gs://redwood-audit-share/iso_evidence/2025-03-22/manifest.csv (includes SHA256)
I will set bucket retention 30d and enable Object Lock for the upload window.
marta (compliance): Thanks @emma @raj. I'll add the control mapping doc and notify procurement/security to update the auditor ACL once uploads complete.
jane_auditor: Great — once uploaded please DM the signed access policy and I will confirm receipt. If you can get the initial bundle by EOD Fri that'd be ideal. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
emma (sec-eng): On it. I'll ping when the PRs + logs are uploaded.
raj (infra-sec): ETA: uploading tomorrow morning 0900 PT. Will post the gs:// links and manifest when done.
marta (compliance): closing the loop here — will follow up if auditor needs more. :lock:
